Metadata.InquiriesOrToReportAnIssue: Contact information for inquiries or to report issues is not available in the provided sources.
Metadata.GlobalAvailability: DermGPT is available to dermatologists and is free to use [SOURCE 3].
Metadata.Summary: DermGPT is an AI chatbot designed to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and save time for physicians [SOURCE 3, SOURCE 4]. It is built on a database of over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3].
Metadata.Keywords: AI; artificial intelligence; dermatology; chatbot; clinical efficiency; prior authorization; patient education

UsesAndDirections.IntendedUseAndWorkflow: DermGPT is intended to assist dermatologists and their staff in everyday practice by providing quick access to dermatology information, answering clinical queries, assisting with patient management, and generating patient education handouts [SOURCE 3, SOURCE 4]. It can be used to look up diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.PrimaryIntendedUsers: The primary intended users are dermatologists, RNs, MAs, and ancillary staff [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.NecessaryKnowledgeExpertise: Users need a basic understanding of dermatology and clinical workflows [SOURCE 4]. The platform's user interface is designed to be intuitive and user-friendly [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.HowToUse: Dermatologists can sign up at www.dermgpt.com to start using it clinically [SOURCE 3]. The platform is designed to be intuitive and user-friendly [SOURCE 4].
UsesAndDirections.TargetedPatientPopulation: DermGPT assists in providing care to a broad range of dermatology patients [SOURCE 3].
UsesAndDirections.PatientConsentOrDisclosureRequiredOrSugg: DermGPT can provide informed consent language regarding procedures and telehealth consults [SOURCE 4]

Warnings.DeveloperSuppliedWarnings: DermGPT should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker but as an assistant to medical care [SOURCE 4].
Warnings.ModelLimitations: DermGPT is most powerful when paired with a dermatology provider or staff who can complement its skills with their higher-level creative problem-solving. It does not replace medical care or decision-making, and should not be used as a stand-alone decision maker, but as an assistant. [SOURCE 4]

TrustIngredients.AISystemFacts: DermGPT is an AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles that aims to streamline clinical tasks, improve access to dermatologic data, and help save time for physicians. [SOURCE 3, 4]
TrustIngredients.ModelType: AI chatbot using natural language processing.
TrustIngredients.InteractionWithOtherSystems: DermGPT can integrate with existing EHR systems to streamline documentation and facilitate seamless information exchange. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.OutcomesAndOutput: DermGPT provides dermatologists with relevant and helpful answers to questions asked in natural language. It can assist with medication options, dosing, interactions, summarize diagnosis and treatment guidelines, suggest labs, imaging, procedures, automate documentation, write insurance authorization letters, and create patient handouts. [SOURCE 3, 4]
TrustIngredients.TypeAndValueOfSolutionOutput: The solution offers a timesaving enterprise chatbot, an AI-powered dermatological colleague trained with chat, reasoning, writing abilities, and customized with a dermatology-specific database. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.ExplanationForHowAnOutputIsGenerated: DermGPT pulls information from a proprietary database of trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals, unlike general language models like ChatGPT. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.FoundationModelsUsedInApplicationIfAppli: DermGPT uses AI chatbot built on more than 3,000 peer-reviewed articles [SOURCE 3]
TrustIngredients.InputDataSource: DermGPT is built on a proprietary database of over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 3]
TrustIngredients.OutputInputDataType: Input: Natural language questions. Output: Dermatological information including diagnoses, treatments, and prior authorization criteria; patient management and shared decision-making tools; answers to patient inquiries. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.DevelopmentDataCharacterization: The AI is powered by proven, curated AI and developed by Faranak Kamangar, MD. [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.TrainingData: The training data consists of over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles. [SOURCE 3]
TrustIngredients.DatasetTransparency: DermGPT's database is proprietary and pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources and peer-reviewed medical journals [SOURCE 4]
TrustIngredients.SkinToneDiversity: Episode 14 of The Future of Dermatology podcast mentions melanoma in skin of color as one of the trending dermatology topics in 2023. [SOURCE 1]
TrustIngredients.RelevanceOfTrainingDataToIntendedPopulat: DermGPT is trained on over 3,000 peer-reviewed articles, making it relevant for dermatologists seeking reliable and trustworthy information [SOURCE 3].
TrustIngredients.BiasMitigationApproaches: DermGPT uses a proprietary database of physician-approved sources to avoid the types of errors (wrong answers and hallucinations) that can occur with general language models [SOURCE 3, 4].
TrustIngredients.OngoingMaintenance: DermGPT is continuously updated and improved [SOURCE 4].
TrustIngredients.TransparencyInformation: DermGPT only pulls from trusted, physician-approved sources [SOURCE 4].

UsefulnessEfficacy.GoalOfMetrics: The goal is to improve patient care and streamline dermatology practices by assisting with ever-increasing clinical tasks and making dermatology information readily available [SOURCE 4].
UsefulnessEfficacy.Result: DermGPT aims to save dermatologists time, leading to more efficient patient care, decreased wait times, and less physician burnout [SOURCE 4].
UsefulnessEfficacy.Interpretation: Minutes saved in a day because of DermGPT will yield more efficient patient care, decreased wait times to see a dermatologist, and less physician burnout [SOURCE 4].

Resources.StakeholdersConsultedDuringDesignOfSolut: Episode 10 of The Future of Dermatology podcast features a conversation about barriers, stakeholders, and connections between patients, doctors, and everyone else involved in healthcare. [SOURCE 1]
